I replied in Ilse's DM: she told me on 14 Oct that her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30 from now on, and she hasn't mentioned a change since.

I got this from her DM history, not from gbrain. When I looked up the note I'd saved under her name in gbrain, it came back empty, so it looks like that saved note can't be read back.

Separately, last time my wrap-up to you also ended up as a message in her DM. It only described saving her own preference, so nothing leaked.
